corrections.reason: The cross-reference to Matthew 9:32 clearly prints ፴፪ (32) rather than ፴፩ (31).
In Ge'ez Luke 11:16, the 3rd person masculine plural imperfect verb is ወየኀሥሡ ('and they were seeking'), with the 2nd order (ካዕብ) suffix on ሡ.
Canonical Ge'ez Luke 11:17 reads 'ወውእቱ አእመሮሙ ኅሊና ልቦሙ' (knowing the thoughts of their hearts), where the cramped bottom-line glyphs ኅሊና ልቦ were misread as ሀይሂልቦ.
Both the printed image and canonical Ge'ez Luke 11:19 read ይኰንኑክሙ ('they shall be your judges', glossed in L29 as ይፈራረዱባችኋል).
At the end of line 29, there is a slightly faded ባ after ይፈራረዱ, forming the grammatically required Amharic verb ይፈራረዱባችኋል across the line wrap.
Canonical Ge'ez Luke 11:23 reads 'ዘኢሀሎ ምስሌየ ፀርየ ውእቱ' (glossed as ባለጋራዬ ነው in L33-34). The printed text has ፀርየ (with a smudge/space), which was misread as ሰድውየ.
